security_contracts: AES-256-GCM at rest; AAD user ID + provider
metadata only; no API key, ciphertext or suffix returned
no API key in browser storage, chat payload, conversation, model prompt, log/audit or URL
actual user isolation, not household ownership
delegated actor cannot manage or inherit saved key
fresh application instance with same DB/server encryption secret reuses saved key
explicit delete and parent data-reset remove only own setting
invalid replacement preserves previous encrypted row
quota saves as unverified; error remains explicit with no default provider fallback
tampered ciphertext/provider or wrong master secret gives actionable 409, not fallback
stale metadata cannot override successful save; failed delete does not pretend success
limitations: All provider HTTP mocked: no live Gemini/Groq/Hugging Face inference or billing tested by developer.
A model label is not itself proof of live inference or model quality.
Shared demo account credentials let other sign-ins consume saved provider quota; do not store personal keys there.
Encryption is at rest, not end-to-end; server decrypts to call provider. Protect server DB and master encryption secrets.
Browser chat history remains in memory; this feature persists the provider setting, not conversation transcripts.
Targeted claim guards are not a general semantic truth verifier.
No changes installed on the user PC; merge and restart are required.
